edits.previous: [Structural Subtype packages](../evidence/structural-subtype-promotion-20261011.md) have installed checks across all seventeen profiles on both source routes. The fixtures cover primitive leaves inside Array, List, Option, products and Except, mixed Fin, transparent aliases and one closed List specialization. [Nominal npm checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-npm-acceptance-20261011.md) add the tested Nat record/variant fields, aliases and constructor-free results on Node 22.23.2 with strict TypeScript. [Nominal C/C++ checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-native-acceptance-20261011.md) add those Nat forms on both source routes in Linux x64/glibc 2.36, including standalone result-only packages. [Nominal Python checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-python-acceptance-20261012.md) add those Nat forms on CPython 3.11 and 3.12 using the same reproduced wheel, offline installation and relocated replay. [Nominal Ruby checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-ruby-acceptance-20261012.md) add those Nat forms on MRI Ruby 3.3.12 through reproduced gems, offline installation and relocated replay on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. [Nominal Rust checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-rust-acceptance-20261012.md) add those Nat forms with Rust and Cargo 1.90.0, offline crate installation, relocated replay and execution after deleting all consumer sources on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. [Nominal C# checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-dotnet-20261012.md) add those Nat forms with .NET SDK 8.0.424 and shared framework 8.0.30, offline NuGet installation, relocated replay and source-free deployment on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. [Nominal Java/Kotlin checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-jvm-20261013.md) add those Nat forms with JDK 22.0.2 and Kotlin 2.2.0, offline installation, relocated replay and source-free deployment of both consumers on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. [Nominal native PHP checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-php-20261013.md) add those Nat forms with PHP 8.2.33 and Composer 2.5.5, offline installation and weak/strict replay before and after relocation on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. Author/build roots are removed before installation; consumer PHP source remains required at runtime. [Nominal WIT/WASI checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-wit-promotion-20261013.md) add the tested Nat records, variants, aliases and constructor-free results through the actual Component Model adapter and its required packaged native Lean host. Both source routes reproduce packages from two roots, install offline and replay after relocation on Linux x64/glibc 2.36 with Wasmtime 42.0.1. [Nominal browser checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-browser-promotion-20261014.md) add the tested Nat fields and constructor-free outputs on both source routes in Chromium 151.0.7922.34, Firefox 153.0 and WebKit 26.5 pages, React and workers, with reproduced component/runtime archives and missing-asset and lifecycle recovery checks. [Nominal PHP-Wasm checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-php-wasm-promotion-20261014.md) add both source routes and API modes on wasm32 PHP 8.4.1 in Node 22.23.2 and Chromium 151.0.7922.34. Embedded, Composer and bundled callers pass startup/lazy loading and weak/strict execution twice after relocation; all three reproduced archives are retained. [Nineteen-base npm checks](../evidence/nominal-primitive-subtype-npm-20261014/index.json) extend Node record and variant fields to every admitted primitive base on both source routes, with per-site normalization, constructor-free results, offline installation and relocated JavaScript/strict-TypeScript replay. Complete component/runtime archives are retained. [Nineteen-base Python checks](../evidence/nominal-primitive-subtype-python-20261014/index.json) extend the same nominal fields and constructor-free results to both author routes on CPython 3.11.16 and 3.12.14. Two author roots reproduce each complete wheel; both interpreter floors install it offline after author removal and replay after physical relocation on Linux x64/glibc 2.36 with 64-bit machine words. Other-host primitive-base nominal acceptance, refined callbacks, owned, recursive, dependent and broader generic Subtypes remain pending.
